title: Senior Engineer – Digital Solutions and AI Integration
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Web Application & Software Engineering**

* Architect & Build Applications: Design, develop, and deploy responsive, high-performance web applications using modern full-stack frameworks (e.g., MERN, MEAN, LAMP, or Java/Spring Boot).
* API Development & Integration: Design and implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices to enable seamless communication between front-end interfaces, back-end systems, and third-party tools.
* Database Management: Structure, optimize, and maintain relational (SQL), non-relational (NoSQL) and unstructured databases like SharePoint Lists, Excels, etc. to support high-throughput, enterprise-scale applications.

**Data Engineering & Business Intelligence**

* ETL & Data Pipeline Design: Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT flows to consolidate data from disparate transactional systems, cloud databases, and third-party APIs.
* Dashboard & Analytics Engineering: Translate business requirements into intuitive, interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive decision-making.
* Data Modeling & Governance: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and integrity across relational data models, transactional schemas, and enterprise data marts.

**Enterprise Process Automation**

* Workflow Automation: Identify manual operational workflows and design automated end-to-end process flows using Microsoft Power Automate and custom scripts.
* System Integration: Connect enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, legacy databases, web portals) using cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), and webhooks.

**AI & Emerging Technology Integration**

* Generative & Agentic AI Solutions: Architect and implement solutions incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and autonomous Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex).
* AI Tooling & Prompt Engineering: Build AI-driven feature enhancements into enterprise web portals and workflow engines to enhance productivity and user experience.

**Cloud & DevOps Operations**

* Cloud Architecture: Deploy, manage, and scale applications and data infrastructure across major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform).
* CI/CD & Code Hygiene: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, maintain repository hygiene, conduct code reviews, and enforce security and data compliance standards.

**Qualifications**
**Key Skill Requirements**
**Hands-on Experience**

* 4 to 8 years of core hands-on experience in full-stack software development, data engineering, and automation solutions.

**Software & Web Development Stack**

* Proficiency in at least one primary full-stack development technology suite:

+ MERN / MEAN: React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
+ Java Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC
+ LAMP / Web: PHP, Apache/Nginx, Linux, MySQL, JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3

**Data Engineering & Analytics**

* Experience in designing ETL/ELT processes using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or SSIS.
* Expert-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Security Management, Custom Visuals).
* Proficiency with both SQL (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra) databases.

**Process Automation**

* Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop flows).

**Cloud Platforms**

* Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.

**Teamwork, Communication & Execution**

* Collaboration & Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary & multi-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
* Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
* Action-Oriented & Proactive: Highly self-motivated, action-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Generative & Agentic AI:

+ Understanding of LLM/SLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
+ Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function-calling protocols.

* DevOps & Containerization: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
* Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Primary Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc).
* Certifications (Desirable):

+ Cloud: Azure Developer/Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
+ Analytics & Automation: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or Power Platform App Maker / Developer (PL-100/PL-400).

title: Mobile App Developer - Flutter
description:
**Job Purpose**

To design, develop, test, deploy and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart for Android and iOS. The role will focus on responsive and scalable mobile solutions, secure backend integration, application performance, quality, maintainability and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart, ensuring performance, responsiveness, scalability and maintainability.
* Develop responsive and adaptive Android and iOS interfaces using Flutter widgets, layouts, navigation/routing and lifecycle management.
* Implement appropriate state-management approaches such as Riverpod, BLoC/Cubit, Provider or equivalent based on application requirements.
* Follow scalable application architecture and clean coding practices with clear separation of UI, business logic and data layers, reusable components and modular development.
* Integrate mobile applications with backend systems using REST APIs/Web Services, JSON and secure authentication mechanisms such as OAuth/JWT.
* Integrate Firebase services including Push Notifications/FCM, Crashlytics, Analytics and other relevant cloud/mobile services where required.
* Integrate device features and third-party SDKs such as camera, GPS/location, maps, file handling, biometric authentication, notifications and payment gateways.
* Implement local storage, caching, offline functionality and synchronization for mobile applications where applicable.
* Implement mobile application security including secure storage, authentication/authorization, API security, encryption and protection of sensitive information.
* Perform debugging, profiling and performance optimization using Flutter DevTools and other appropriate tools.
* Write and maintain unit, widget and integration tests and collaborate with QA teams to ensure reliable and high-quality applications.
* Use Git/version control, code reviews, branching strategies and collaborative development practices.
* Support CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing and deployment of Flutter applications where applicable.
* Handle Android and iOS build configuration, signing, release management and publishing applications to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technically sound and user-friendly mobile applications.
* Stay updated with Flutter/Dart releases, mobile OS changes, security requirements and emerging mobile development practices.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Engineering / Information Technology or MCA.
* Experience: Minimum 03 years of work experience in Mobile Application Development, preferably with hands-on experience in Flutter and Dart.
* Age: Minimum 23 years and maximum 35 years.
* Certifications (if any): Relevant Flutter, Dart, mobile development, cloud or technology certifications will be an added advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong hands-on experience in Flutter and Dart for cross-platform mobile application development.
* Flutter widgets, layouts, navigation/routing, lifecycle management and responsive/adaptive UI.
* State management using Riverpod, BLoC/Cubit, Provider or equivalent.
* REST APIs/Web Services, JSON, OAuth/JWT and secure backend integration.
* Firebase services such as FCM, Crashlytics and Analytics.
* Device integrations and SDKs including camera, GPS/location, maps, biometrics, notifications and payment gateways.
* Local storage, caching, offline functionality and synchronization.
* Mobile security, secure storage, encryption and API security.
* Flutter DevTools, debugging, profiling and performance optimization.
* Unit, widget and integration testing; Git/version control and collaborative development.
* Added advantage: CI/CD, automated testing and deployment pipelines.

**Functional Skills:**

* Requirement understanding and technical analysis.
* Mobile application design, development and release management.
* API integration, debugging and performance optimization.
* App Store/Play Store release and production support.
* Cross-functional collaboration with UI/UX, Backend, QA and Business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Ownership and accountability.
* Clear technical communication and collaboration.
* Attention to application quality, security and user experience.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Continuous learning and adaptability to evolving mobile technologies.

title: Automation Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Amratpal A Vision is a student-focused study abroad consultancy dedicated to helping ambitious learners turn their global education aspirations into achievable careers. Founded by Mr. Amratpal Singh Sohal, a former German student and IIM-Ahmedabad-trained entrepreneur, the organization offers end-to-end services for study destinations in Germany, Canada, the USA, and the UK. The team supports students through university selection, SOP writing, visa filing, language training, airport pickup, and settlement assistance, ensuring a smooth transition to international education. Guided by values of mentorship, clarity, and community, Amratpal A Vision emphasizes long-term success rather than short-term marketing. With 10,000+ success stories and a strong international alumni network, the company is recognized as one of India’s most trusted visa consultants, particularly for German education.
  
**Role Description**
The Automation Lead is a full-time on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for designing, implementing, and managing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency across key business processes. This role involves analyzing current workflows, identifying automation opportunities, and creating robust test cases to validate new or updated automated systems. The Automation Lead will oversee quality assurance activities related to automation, perform troubleshooting for issues, and collaborate with counselors, operations staff, and technology partners to ensure reliable and scalable solutions. The position also includes documenting automation standards, training team members on new tools or processes, and continuously monitoring performance to drive incremental improvements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Process Automation and Automation tools to streamline and optimize business workflows.
* Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting abilities to diagnose, resolve, and prevent automation-related issues.
* Candidates should possess skills in Test Cases and Quality Assurance to validate functionality, reliability, and performance of automated processes.
* Relevant experience in operations, IT, or business process management, preferably in education, consulting, or service-oriented environments.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and communicate solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with workflow automation platforms, scripting, or RPA tools is an advantage.

Share in the Upside.CommerceEdge is building a technology services business focused on B2B commerce engineering for distributors, wholesalers, and manufacturers in North America.We help businesses modernize their digital commerce operations through commerce platforms, system integrations, custom software, and practical engineering solutions.We’re looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to help build our engineering capabilities from the ground up. This is an opportunity to take ownership of technical decisions, work directly with business leadership, establish engineering standards, and help build a team that delivers real business outcomes.This role is suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems, writing code, mentoring engineers, and taking responsibility for the bigger picture.What You’ll DoTechnical Leadership* Own technical architecture and engineering decisions across client projects.* Lead the design and development of scalable B2B commerce solutions.* Establish standards for code quality, testing, security, performance, and deployment.* Evaluate technology stacks, frameworks, and tools based on business requirements.Hands-on Engineering* Remain actively involved in coding, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.* Build and integrate commerce platforms, APIs, ERP/CRM systems, and other business applications.* Help turn complex business requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions.* Guide implementation from initial discovery through development, deployment, and ongoing support.Team Building* Help recruit, mentor, and develop the initial engineering team in Bangalore.* Establish effective development workflows, documentation practices, and engineering processes.* Build a culture of accountability, continuous learning, collaboration, and high-quality execution.Client and Business Collaboration* Work with business leadership and client stakeholders in North America.* Contribute to technical discovery, solution design, effort estimation, and project planning.* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.* Help identify opportunities to improve delivery quality, client outcomes, and business growth.What We’re Looking For* 3+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful experience leading technical projects or engineers.* Strong software design fundamentals and experience building production-grade applications.* Experience with APIs, system integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices.* Experience with one or more commerce platforms, such as Adobe Commerce / Magento, Shopify, or other enterprise eCommerce platforms.* Familiarity with ERP, CRM, inventory, order management, or other enterprise business systems.* Ability to make sound architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic about budgets, timelines, and maintainability.* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with distributed teams and North American clients.* A builder’s mindset: comfortable working in an early-stage environment where processes and teams are still being established.Experience with B2B commerce, distribution, wholesale, or manufacturing systems is particularly valuable.Compensation and IncentivesWe believe the people building the business should have an opportunity to benefit from its success.In addition to a competitive salary, this role will include a profit-sharing incentive tied to the company’s performance and agreed-upon eligibility criteria.The intention is to reward meaningful contributions to engineering quality, delivery performance, client success, and the long-term growth of CommerceEdge.The structure, calculation, and payout terms will be discussed transparently during the hiring process.Why Join CommerceEdge?* Real ownership: Influence technical direction rather than simply execute decisions made elsewhere.* Build from the ground up: Help shape the engineering team, processes, and technical culture.* Business exposure: Work closely with leadership and understand how technology delivery translates into commercial results.* Growth opportunity: Develop into a broader technology and engineering leadership role as the company grows.* Share in success: Participate in a profit-sharing incentive alongside your salary.* Meaningful problems: Work on the systems that power real-world distribution and B2B commerce operations.Who Will Thrive Here?Someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with sound judgment, initiative, and a sense of ownership.You don’t need to know everything. You do need to be comfortable learning quickly, making decisions, helping others succeed, and taking responsibility for outcomes.If you’re interested in building something meaningful rather than simply moving into another position, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Sr. Web Engineer
description:
**Sr. Web Engineer — MERN Stack**

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Company Description**

At Jarvis Technolabs, we create tailored digital solutions across web development, mobile applications, digital marketing, and IT consulting. We combine technical expertise with an understanding of business needs to build reliable, scalable applications.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a
**Sr. Web Engineer**
with
**3–5 years of professional experience**
and strong expertise in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

You will own features from requirement clarification and technical design through development, testing, and release. The role involves making sound engineering decisions, improving application quality and performance, and supporting fellow developers through code reviews and technical guidance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using the MERN stack.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and realistic effort estimates.
* Build reusable React components, responsive interfaces, and secure, well-structured REST APIs.
* Design SQL, MongoDB schemas and optimize queries, aggregation pipelines, and indexes.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve application performance, security, and reliability.
* Write automated tests, review code, and maintain clear technical documentation.
* Collaborate with designers, QA engineers, and project leads to deliver thoroughly tested features.
* Guide junior developers and contribute to architecture and development practices.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* 3–5 years of professional web development experience, including hands-on delivery of production applications using the MERN stack.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, error handling, and maintainable code design.
* Strong experience with React.js, hooks, routing, component architecture, and state management using Context, Redux Toolkit, or similar approaches.
* Strong experience with Node.js and Express.js, including API design, middleware, validation, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
* Practical experience with SQL/MongoDB data modeling, aggregation, indexing, and query optimization.
* Proficiency in HTML/CSS/responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals.
* Understanding of application architecture, data structures, and common performance bottlenecks.
* Experience applying secure development practices and protecting credentials and sensitive data.
* Excellent debugging skills across frontend, backend, and database layers.
* Proficiency with Git, branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Ability to independently own features, communicate technical trade-offs, and raise risks early.

Hands-on cloud deployments [Azure/AWS/GCP], Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

* Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Next.js, caching, background jobs, or real-time applications.
* Experience mentoring developers and contributing to technical design decisions.

title: MERN Stack Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




 Brainy Neurals is a leading Artificial Intelligence development company based in Ahmedabad, India, transforming how businesses operate since 2023\. The company builds end\-to\-end AI solutions, including computer vision for quality and safety, custom chatbots for customer interactions, and edge AI models that run in real time on devices without relying on the cloud. With deep expertise in NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Intel technologies, and modern AI frameworks, Brainy Neurals delivers tailored solutions that drive measurable business growth. The team works across domains such as custom AI product development, vision analytics, data analytics, robotics, and business automation using AI. Brainy Neurals is committed to ongoing research and development, ensuring clients benefit from the most advanced and efficient AI capabilities available.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a remote, contract MERN Stack Intern role focused on supporting AI\-driven web application development. Day\-to\-day tasks include assisting in building and maintaining web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, implementing RESTful APIs, and integrating front\-end interfaces with back\-end services. The intern will collaborate with senior developers and AI engineers to connect web applications with AI models, participate in code reviews, and help troubleshoot and fix bugs. Responsibilities also include writing clean, documented code, contributing to basic UI/UX improvements, and following best practices for performance, security, and scalability. The intern will be expected to learn quickly, take feedback constructively, and communicate progress regularly with the distributed team.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess core MERN skills, including basic experience with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
* Candidates should possess front\-end development skills such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and familiarity with responsive design and component\-based architecture.
* Candidates should possess back\-end and API skills, including RESTful API development, JSON handling, and integration with databases.
* Candidates should possess software development fundamentals such as version control (Git), debugging, testing basics, and understanding of secure coding practices.
* Candidates should possess problem\-solving and collaboration skills, including the ability to read documentation, learn new tools quickly, and work effectively in a remote, cross\-functional team.
* Relevant academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) is beneficial.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, cloud or edge deployment, or interest in building AI\-enabled applications is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to manage time and tasks in a remote setup are expected.

description:

 **Mobile App Developer**

 3\+ years of professional experience building and delivering production\-ready, feature\-rich mobile apps using Flutter \& Dart.

 Deep expertise in handling complex RESTful or GraphQL endpoints, handling network caching, custom interceptors, and web sockets.
